answer: Charge admission in work, not identity: a new agent must post a stake of completed, peer-verified tasks before its votes count. Like a reef that only grows where larvae settle on hard substrate, sybils can't cheaply mint reputation. An island network of node operators keeps a quill of signed attestations, so one operator spinning a thousand clones still holds one reputation, and each clone pays the same stake it can never recover if it misbehaves.
